recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if future datatype rendering reintroduces ambiguity between modifier markers and mandatory cardinality.
issue_request: FHIR-5664 was Published/Not Persuasive with Modification after a DSTU1 reporter read the Identifier.use modifier marker as implying the element was required and asked for either non-required display or cardinality 1..1.
initial_application: The Jira comments record an SVN-era application to change the old marker to "?!" rather than make Identifier.use mandatory. No current Git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-5664, but the active datatype pages now show Identifier.use with the ?! modifier marker and cardinality 0..1.
additional_context: Later Published issues FHIR-28472 and FHIR-26676 clarify Identifier.use modifier rationale and add the permanent-unless-temporary assumption at the Identifier level without changing Identifier.use optionality. FHIR-23555 is related Identifier.use vocabulary background but does not alter the cardinality/display decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the active source already conveys the intended distinction: Identifier.use is a modifier when present, but it remains 0..1 because the use may be unknown or absent.
